name: 1c-form-viewer
description: MCP server for visually inspecting 1C managed forms and spreadsheet templates — native Windows exe and the cross-platform Node.js server

scripts.build:assets: npm run clean && npm run sync && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && npm run verify:assets
scripts.start:node: npm run build:assets && npm run build:node && node dist/mcp-server.js
scripts.test: npm run build:assets && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test tests/files.test.ts tests/native-contract.test.ts tests/native-only.test.ts tests/static-server.test.ts tests/node-mcp-server.test.ts
